study.name: H11: 384px PV Diagnostic — Text N=10
study.description:
10 text-only proposer passes at T=0.7 on the full 384px evaluation area
(611 tiles). Post-hoc consensus sweep at all thresholds (1-of-10 through
10-of-10), each fed through the PV pipeline. Tests whether moderate
consensus + PV rescues 384px precision while retaining its high recall.
